title: One building, one truss: an IFC loss receipt and a roof truss with a margin on every member
question: What does the Confluence building lose on its way from IFC to X3D, and can a canopy truss be designed over its court, checked by two solvers, and carried through IFC and X3D with every member's identity and numbers intact?
label: A worked study. Not a certified design and not for construction. No engineer of record has reviewed it.

units.length: m in the analysis; mm in the IFC files (IfcSIUnit MILLI METRE, declared explicitly); m in X3D
units.frame: IFC: z up. X3D: y up, reached by one Transform named IFC_ZUP_TO_YUP with rotation 1 0 0 -pi/2

inputs.x3d: x3d.demo/docs/demos/confluence-ifc/v1/snapshot/scene-0.x3d, written from that IFC by the Confluence studio server

panels.what: equal panels in a parallel-chord Pratt truss

depth.what: centre to centre of the chords

truss_line_y.what: the truss sits on the column line y = 1

tributary_width.what: half the bay to each neighbouring column line (y = -4 and y = 6)

chord_b.what: chords: square hollow section, outside width

Fy.source: ASTM A36/A36M, 36 ksi [250 MPa]; search summary, 27 Nov 2026: Likely. A real hollow section would be another grade; kept at 250 MPa so both studies share one number

E.source: 29,000 ksi in AISC 360: from memory, Likely

live_roof.source: ASCE/SEI 7 minimum roof live load as remembered; the table was not read: Suspected

K.what: effective length factor, every member pinned at both ends, braced at every panel point

codes.text: Fe = pi^2 E / (KL/r)^2; Fcr = 0.658^(Fy/Fe) Fy when KL/r <= 4.71 sqrt(E/Fy), else 0.877 Fe; phi_c = 0.90
codes.read_from: Purdue CE 470 course notes quoting the specification (search summary, 27 Nov 2026). The 360-22 text itself was not opened

codes.text: KL/r preferably not above 200 for compression members

codes.read_from: memory. A search for the 7-22 text returned a forum transcription in another form, and 7-22 changed the snow factor; the roof live factor 1.6 is the same in both as far as I can tell
memory of IBC Table 1604.3; treated as a study criterion

load_cases.what: 1.2 D + 1.6 Lr on the whole span
1.2 D + 1.6 Lr on the west half only (pattern loading, chosen: it is what reverses the web members)

requirements.shall: Every IFC product that has geometry shall be found in the X3D file by its GlobalId, with the same name and class, for the building (111) and for the truss (33). Nothing in the X3D shall be absent from the IFC.
For every matched element the bounding box, surface area and volume recomputed from the X3D mesh shall equal those recomputed from the IFC by IfcOpenShell.
Every IFC attribute, property and relationship kind shall be either carried into X3D or named on the loss list. A key on neither list fails.
Under the envelope of LC1, LC2 and LC3, demand shall not exceed design strength in any member (tension: D2 yielding; compression: E3).
Every member that sees compression in any case shall have KL/r no greater than 200.
Midspan deflection under D + Lr shall not exceed span / 240.
The span and the bearing level shall be read from the IFC columns, not typed.

references.what: member forces: joint equilibrium (36 equations, own elimination) against the direct stiffness method
method of sections for the two balanced cases: chord = M / h, diagonal = V sqrt(p^2 + h^2) / h
the sum of the reactions equals the sum of the loads
midspan deflection: unit-load (virtual work) sum against the stiffness solution
the two branches of E3 meet at KL/r = 4.71 sqrt(E/Fy)
geometry: IfcOpenShell's reading of the IFC against this study's reading of the X3D

exchange.identity: IFC GlobalId, carried as MetadataString name='guid' in MetadataSet name='IFC'

controls.what: two X3D elements exchange their GlobalIds: every count still matches, the quantities do not
one element removed from the X3D
the X3D coordinates compared without the unit scale
the X3D read in its y-up frame, without undoing IFC_ZUP_TO_YUP
one diagonal deleted: the truss is a mechanism and must be reported as one, not solved
the stiffness solver's member force with its sign flipped
the hand formula with depth 0.9 m
LC3 left out: the envelope no longer covers every declared case
node coordinates 1000 times too large with the loads unchanged: a determinate truss keeps the same forces, so only capacity and deflection can see it
the E3 limit typed as 4.17 instead of 4.71
span typed as 8.4 m instead of read from the columns

exploration.when: 27 Nov 2026, before the limits were written
exploration.numbers: Building only (the truss had not been run): 111 of 111 elements matched by GlobalId; worst bounding-box difference 5.3e-6 mm, worst area difference 2.5e-8 relative, worst volume difference 8.1e-9 relative; total volume 300.95 m3. IfcOpenShell 0.9.0.post1.
exploration.honesty: The building limits were written with these numbers in view and are derived from function. The truss limits were written before any truss solver ran.

bbox_diff_mm.why: one hundredth of the IFC file's own length unit (1 mm)

area_rel.why: X3D text carries 7 to 9 significant digits; a part in a million is a real change of shape, not rounding

utilisation.why: R4: demand / design strength, resistance factors already inside the strength

solver_agreement_rel.why: REF1, REF2, REF4: two exact routes to one linear answer, relative to the largest force or deflection

e3_continuity_rel.why: REF5: 0.658^2.25 and 0.877 / 2.25 differ by 0.05 % by construction of the specification's rounded constants

span_from_ifc_mm.why: R7: the span used must be within 1 mm of the column centre distance read from the IFC
